pages.text: Applies fan processing without a fan. Put the $(l)catalyst$() in your offhand, hold right-click to charge, release to blow.\n\nWorks on items on belts, depots and basins — and on mobs.

pages.title: Catalysts it recognises
pages.text: Not limited to vanilla: any fan processing type registered by another mod can be triggered. Catalysts are discovered from$(br)$(li)item / block / fluid tags named $(c)<ns>:fan_processing_catalysts/<type>$() or $(c)<ns>:fan_catalysts/<type>$()$(br)$(li)colored dye buckets (Dragons Plus)$(br)$(li)dye catalysts (Create Connected)

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(li)Conflicts (one item claimed by several types) are logged as a WARN — resolve with $(c)bellows_type_overrides$() in the config.$(br)$(li)It produces $(o)no$() Create air current, so block-dyeing logic that needs airflow won't trigger.$(br)$(li)Entity conversion happens instantly on release, not after sustained blowing.
